The '''Themians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Near-Human]]s from the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Themis]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were ruled by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lumon]].
